name: flowcode
description: Harness engineering orchestration layer for AI coding agents

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const s=p.join('src','defaults','skills'),d=p.join('dist','defaults','skills');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.md')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f)));console.log('Skills copied')" && node dist/postinstall.js
